fusions.name: Twin Flight
fusions.desc: Looses 2 arrows at once, spread wide apart, each dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Parting Ways
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits to 1 more enemy within 4 tiles for 80% of that. Your afflictions on the first target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Turned Tines
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it instead.

fusions.name: Second Branch
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
